component.name: jev
component.title: Jev
component.description: Evaluate text and structured state with the TypeSafe AI Jev decision API.
component.label: ai

baseUrl.label: common
baseUrl.description: The API base URL. The client appends /v1/systemone. Redirects are not followed.

configuration.description: Default configuration shared by Jev endpoints.

model.label: common
model.description: The model ID or alias. Use a versioned ID to pin decision behavior.

questions.label: common
questions.description: A JSON object mapping question names to Noul, Choice or Score question objects. When set, producers evaluate the selected message state; otherwise the body must contain a complete request map.

requestTimeout.label: common
requestTimeout.description: The timeout in milliseconds for the complete HTTP request and response body. Must be positive.

state.label: common
state.description: The Simple expression selecting state for configured questions. If not set, the message body is used.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

resultProperty.label: producer
resultProperty.description: Store the producer response in this exchange property, preserving the original message body.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

apiKey.label: security
apiKey.description: The API key used for Bearer authentication.
